subject: microbiology
title: Herpesviruses: HSV, VZV, EBV, CMV, HHV6 and HHV8

steps.tx: **Herpes simplex 1 and 2** (enveloped dsDNA, latency in **trigeminal and sacral ganglia**) erupt as grouped vesicles on erythematous bases: HSV-1 oral cold sores with keratitis (dendritic ulcer threatening vision) and temporal lobe **encephalitis** (fever with aphasia, temporal MRI changes, RBCs in CSF), HSV-2 genital ulcers with neonatal herpes (vaginal delivery through active lesions avoided by section). **Tzanck smear** (multinucleated giant cells) with **Cowdry A inclusions** bedsides while PCR confirms; **aciclovir** (viral thymidine kinase activated, needs hydration against crystal nephropathy) treats with valaciclovir suppression for recurrences.
steps.say: Grouped vesicles that recur are herpes: latent in ganglia. Temporal fever with aphasia is HSV encephalitis: aciclovir now.

steps.tx: **Varicella zoster virus** (same ganglion latency, dorsal root) causes **chickenpox** (centripetal vesicles in crops with fever, infectious until all crusted) then decades later **shingles** (dermatomal burning vesicles, thoracic commonest, **Ramsay Hunt** with facial palsy and ear vesicles, ophthalmic division threatening sight). Postherpetic neuralgia (elderly) needs gabapentinoids with early antivirals shortening; **varicella vaccine** (live, contacts and seronegative pregnancy exposed get VZIG) prevents. Breakthrough disease runs mild.
steps.say: Crops centripetal then crusts are chickenpox. Dermatomal burn in elders is shingles: antivirals within 72 hours.

steps.tx: **Epstein-Barr virus** (B cell latency via CD21, salivary spread in adolescents) causes **infectious mononucleosis** (fever with exudative pharyngitis, posterior cervical nodes and splenomegaly; **atypical lymphocytes** with **heterophile Monospot**, amoxicillin rash unmasking, splenic rupture avoided by rest). Tumour links (African **Burkitt lymphoma** with jaw mass and c-myc, **nasopharyngeal carcinoma**, post transplant **PTLD**) need biopsy; chronic active infection debates follow. CMV heterophile negative mononucleosis mimics without pharyngitis.
steps.say: Kissing disease with atypical cells and amoxicillin rash is EBV. Jaw mass in African child is Burkitt.

steps.tx: **Cytomegalovirus** (largest herpesvirus, **owl eye basophilic inclusions**, latency in monocytes) harms the immunocompromised and fetuses: **congenital CMV** (commonest infectious deafness with microcephaly and petechiae, valganciclovir debated), transplant retinitis (pizza pie haemorrhages, **ganciclovir** with neutropenia watched) and colitis. **HHV-6** causes **roseola infantum** (high fever then rash as fever breaks, febrile seizures), and **HHV-8** drives **Kaposi sarcoma** (violaceous AIDS plaques) with primary effusion lymphoma. Serology with PCR and pp65 antigenaemia stage.
steps.say: Pizza pie retina in transplant is CMV: ganciclovir. Fever that breaks into rash in infants is roseola.
